In one sentence: given only two correlated trailing indicators and a lagging outcome metric on an annual-renewal contract base, the evidence cannot yet distinguish a real onboarding/service-friction degradation from a purely cohort-composition artifact (a single bad sales cohort ~12 months ago is, by itself, quantitatively sufficient to explain the entire churn jump) — so the recommended move is a 2-4 week diagnostic sprint plus no-regret interim actions before committing to any specific fix, at LOW confidence on which root cause will ultimately be confirmed, though the "diagnose before fixing" process call itself is robust under sensitivity testing.
